mobbin:51398a50-ab88-4cb6-8d7d-08e18e411.summary: A lock-screen Live Activity shows a Rest countdown with dismiss, then a Study countdown with a progress bar, then a completed-focus summary with restart and today's total.
steps: Lock screen Live Activity: Rest and X
Lock screen Live Activity: Study with progress
Lock screen done: duration and restart
steal: During Rest, large remaining time, a phase label and one X control appear without unlocking.
During Study, the same chrome adds a thin progress bar under the phase label.
When done, the lock screen shows outcome text, a start-to-end clock range, a restart control and today's total.
avoid: This depends on native Live Activities. That clashes with a preferred web debrief client and phone-ban exams. Treat it as a native-only pattern, not the primary MVP surface.
mobbin:51398a50-ab88-4cb6-8d7d-08e18e411.fit: Mobile and iPad app: only mobile can show phase time on the lock screen (desktop and SRV cannot). That is strong evidence the timer job benefits from a phone. Extend room timers with always-visible remaining time for faculty holding devices between tasks.

mobbin:3ff1275c-8826-4b99-b53c-abb5a3c45.summary: The Dynamic Island shows a compact sprout and countdown while the app is backgrounded, then expands to countdown, Rest phase label, and an X stop control.
steps: Expanded Island: Rest and X stop
steal: Compact: remaining time stays in the system chrome while you work elsewhere in the OS.
Expanded: a phase label under the time plus a single X ends the timer without opening the app.
avoid: iPhone Dynamic Island only is useless on generic tablets or web and during phone-banned graded exams. Do not require it.
mobbin:3ff1275c-8826-4b99-b53c-abb5a3c45.fit: Mobile and iPad app: this shows why mobile (not the SRV) can keep a session timer glanceable during other work. Prefer a lock-screen or widget-like always-on timer where the OS allows, with a large in-app fallback for web and tablet.
